title: Purchase World of Warcraft: Forever Upgrades and Begin Your Next Journey in Azeroth
author: Blizzard Entertainment

short_news.title_en: Purchase World of Warcraft: Forever Upgrades and Begin Your Next Journey in Azeroth

changes.text: Access to the new Skyborne race and their Zephras Isle starting experience
Everything in the Skyborne Heroic Pack

This is a limited-time bundle that connects Warcraft’s strategy roots with your first steps in World of Warcraft: Forever, including the origins of the Forsaken Paladins, the Undercity, and more! Includes:
Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom campaign
Purchase World of Warcraft: Forever upgrade editions on the Battle.net Shop today.

path: Explore Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom
changes.text: Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom is also available as a digital purchase for Warcraft III players. This all-new campaign returns Warcraft’s RTS roots to the front line with a story set around the fall of Lordaeron, the founding of the Undercity, and the first Forsaken Paladin. Players can purchase the campaign on its own, pick up a combo that includes Warcraft III: Reforged, or choose the Warcraft Forever Collection to get both the campaign and WoW: Forever upgrade benefits in one limited-time bundle.

path: Explore Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom
changes.text: Purchase Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom separately on the Battle.net Shop or get it as an included benefit of the Warcraft Forever Collection.

Whether you’re returning to familiar lands, stepping into Azeroth for the first time, or following the story from Warcraft III into the earliest days of World of Warcraft, your next adventure is ready to be carved into legend. Choose your edition, gather your friends, and make this world your home.
Warcraft Forever Collection will be available through January 11, 2027.
Purchase Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom separately on the Battle.net Shop, or get it as an included benefit of the Warcraft Forever Collection.
